improvementsLog.title: Dirty Tab Close Confirmation Modal
improvementsLog.detail: If a user attempts to close a tab with 'Unsaved changes' (or navigates away), trigger a clean modal: 'Discard changes or Save before closing?' with keyboard accelerators (Enter=Save, Esc=Cancel, D=Discard).
improvementsLog.marketBenchmark: VS Code and Microsoft Business Central dirty tab guard

improvementsLog.title: Spreadsheet Keyboard Navigation in Repeater Grids (Excel-grade)
improvementsLog.detail: Allow power users to use Arrow keys (Up/Down/Left/Right) to navigate between cells, F2 to edit, Enter to confirm and move down, and Tab to move to next cell, matching Excel and Navision classic client speed.
improvementsLog.marketBenchmark: Microsoft Dynamics NAV / BC high-speed 10-key numeric entry

improvementsLog.title: Contextual AI Copilot in Action Bar
improvementsLog.detail: Embed an AI Assistant action button directly on list/card pages that can summarize ledger anomalies, suggest line item categorizations, or auto-complete tax codes using local LLM sidecars.
improvementsLog.marketBenchmark: Microsoft Copilot in Dynamics 365 Business Central
